frontmatter.purpose: Recognizable Horizons identity; actual level and edition; a usable student name field.
Two units per page; exact lesson titles and lesson pages; language and vocabulary; primary B skill; useful output. Add practice-bank starts and review destinations.

frontmatter.section: How to use Horizons and digital/audio guide
frontmatter.purpose: Explain lesson codes, real track playback, NEW WORDS, Go-to practice, Extra Practice and Beyond Horizons; show one real tested viewer QR and a printed short URL. Future Blooket reserves stay blank.

backmatter.purpose: Alphabetical grammar and vocabulary topics with actual lesson and practice destinations; do not repeat all word banks.
Ten course-taught base forms plus past; full useful chunks, source lesson links; omit past participles because not taught.
A helpful sound/stress guide based on actual models and real audio pointers: alphabet1.4; busy/fun1B; -ed7.9. Do not invent an appendix recording.
Eight source-linked can-do goals with meaningful evidence/result notes and one next step, rather than generic completion ticks.
Clearly headed, generous lined writing pages inspired by attached sample; small prompt such as Words I want to use may support personal study.
Clear level/series identity and tested digital destination without fake commercial claims.

optional_not_needed_for_initial_completi.reason: Long and duplicative; full scripts already exist as online resources. A clear audio guide/index is more economical.
Teacher resources already exist; do not reveal controlled answers inside the Student Book.
A separate substantial product with fresh tasks; not necessary to finish a Student Book and should not duplicate practice banks.

recommendations.page_budget: About 8 front pages plus 9 back pages before existing credits; adapt the contents density and cover folio policy without shrinking type. Current lessons already begin at printed5; insertion needs one explicit pagination plan and regenerated references.
production_constraints: Do not claim ISBN, publisher registrations, certifications or app access that are not documented.
Do not add past participles, present perfect or future forms to fill a reference table.
Use actual current lesson titles and source genres; no rigid B-lesson alternation claim.
Keep all existing 16 future Blooket squares blank until real games are provided.
Base the audio guide on printed badges and custom files, not all files in Audios; orphaned production files are not current student recordings.
